signals.subject: Harborview Medical Center \.74B design-build contract — landmark healthcare win
signals.detail: Mortenson + Perkins and Will selected as design-build team for King County \.74B Harborview Bond Program (new inpatient tower + ED expansion + seismic retrofits of older buildings). Construction to begin 2027-2028. Structural engineer of record to be selected as part of the program.

signals.subject: Todd Buchanan joins as new Managing Director December 2025, replacing 20-year leader Kay Kornovich
signals.detail: Major leadership transition. Buchanan brings civic, healthcare, and aviation focus. His appointment signals a strategic push to grow healthcare, higher education, life sciences, and workplace design in Seattle.

signals.subject: Kaiser Borsari Hall, Western Washington University — mass timber STEM building
signals.detail: First higher-ed STEM building in US targeting Zero Energy and Zero Carbon; mass timber structure; Holcim Foundation Bronze Award (North America). 53,345 sf. Completed 2024.

signals.subject: Ai2 Headquarters, Seattle — 50,000 sf mass timber office

signals.subject: Harborview \.74B project will absorb significant SE capacity through 2028
signals.detail: The Harborview Bond Program requires a Structural Engineer of Record as a separately procured consultant. This mega-project creates both a direct SE procurement opportunity and likely capacity strain on Perkins and Will SE roster for other projects.

actions.recommendation: PRIORITY TARGET — Harborview \.74B Bond Program SE procurement. The program is procuring a Structural Engineer of Record separately. KOR should formally submit for this role. The seismic retrofit components of older hospital buildings are directly aligned with KOR seismic expertise. This is the single largest SE opportunity in the PNW for 2026-2028.
actions.timingNotes: Urgent — procurement process likely underway or imminent in 2026.

actions.recommendation: TARGET MASS TIMBER: Todd Buchanan first year as Managing Director is the optimal window to introduce KOR as a structural partner. Kaiser Borsari Hall and Ai2 HQ demonstrate Perkins and Will Seattle commitment to mass timber design. Pitch KOR on seismic mass timber credentials and cross-border BC/WA licensure.

Perkins and Will Seattle SE partnerships: Coughlin Porter Lundeen (UW Life Sciences Building), no confirmed SE on Kaiser Borsari Hall or Ai2 HQ from public sources. CPL appears to be one SE relationship but not the only one. The new Managing Director and Harborview SE procurement create an open competitive field.

Todd Buchanan is in his first 6 months as MD (December 2025). New leaders typically audit and expand their consultant rosters. Q1-Q3 2026 is the optimal window to be introduced before he solidifies his preferred SE list.
actions.timingNotes: Q3 2026 — within first year of new MD tenure.

narratives.paragraphText: Perkins and Will Seattle is in a transformative moment: a new Managing Director (Todd Buchanan, December 2025) replacing a 20-year leader, and a landmark \.74B Harborview Medical Center design-build contract won in 2025. The office has demonstrated a clear mass timber commitment with Kaiser Borsari Hall (first US Zero Energy/Carbon STEM building, 2024) and the Ai2 Headquarters (2025). The Harborview program requires a separately procured Structural Engineer of Record — the single largest SE opportunity in the Pacific Northwest for 2026-2028.

KOR must act on two fronts simultaneously: (1) Introduce KOR to Todd Buchanan within his first year as MD (by Q3 2026) to position for general roster inclusion, and (2) Formally pursue the Harborview SE of Record role — monitor King County OMWBE and Harborview Bond Program procurement portal for the SE RFQ. KOR seismic hospital retrofit expertise, mass timber structural credentials, and cross-border BC/WA licensure all directly align with the scope of the Harborview program.
